description: Use this when the user wants a reply to one buying signal, such as "draft a reply to the first post" after find_buying_intent. Pass service and signal, one find_buying_intent or weekly_brief result whole, as it came, for example {"service": "SEO audit", "signal": {"source": "hackernews", "url": "https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=1", "date": "2026-10-20", "label": "intent", "signals": ["looking for"], "quote": "Looking for an SEO audit for our shop"}}. Returns a 3-line draft built from the result's company, role, stack or quote, the reason to reply and checks before sending; a result without its company or quote is refused. Plain rules, no AI model. Draft only: it sends nothing, opens no link, has no recipient and fills in no name. Not for finding leads (use find_buying_intent).

service.description: The service you sell, as in find_buying_intent, such as "SEO audit"

signal.description: One result from find_buying_intent or weekly_brief, passed as it came. Its source, url, date, label, signals, company, role, stack and quote are read. hn_hiring, job_changes and partners results need their company, and post results their quote: the draft names them, and a signal without one is refused

company.description: The result's company: needed for hn_hiring, job_changes and partners

quote.description: The result's quote: needed for hackernews, github and stackexchange

url.description: The https link of the result

name: draft_follow_up

draft.description: The three lines joined by line breaks, to edit and send yourself

lead_source.description: The buying-signal source to store with a reply sent from this draft

lines.description: The draft in three lines: the opener, the useful line, the disclosure or easy close

notice.description: What the draft is and is not. Pass it on

reason.description: One line on why this lead has a reason to reply now

sent.description: Always false: this tool sends nothing

title: Draft a follow-up with a reason to reply
